array.string: # launchd's default PATH hides every package manager outside /usr/bin export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" # terminal-notifier is only granted notification permission when launched through LaunchServices notify() { open -g -n /opt/homebrew/opt/terminal-notifier/terminal-notifier.app --args "$@" -group "local.mpm-plan"; } mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/mpm" /opt/homebrew/bin/mpm --no-color --table-format json outdated > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json" 2> "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.log" status=$? if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then rm -f "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" total=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq '[.[].packages | length] | add // 0' "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json") if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then notify -title "Update(s) available" -message "mpm found $total update(s). Open a new shell for details." fi else printf 'mpm outdated failed (exit %s) at %s -- see ~/.cache/mpm/plan.log\n' "$status" "$(date)" > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" notify -title "Couldn't check for updates" -message "mpm hit an error. Open a new shell for details." fi
